job.interpretation: The trainer intentionally returned exit code 3 after completing all 20 optimizer groups because semantic gates failed; this was not an OOM or an incomplete run.

decision.next_action: Repair and validate the Stage2-L objectives and gates with an offline/head-level diagnostic before another A800 smoke.

diagnosis: Language fitting improved, but cross-family QA preference worsened and generated answers remained malformed, so the model did not demonstrate stable UQ semantics.
The exact 2/3 stance accuracy equals the majority-class baseline for two maintain labels and one conservative label per group; it is not evidence of on-path understanding.
The minimum target-stance probability fell from 0.3238 to 0.1442, consistent with majority-class collapse despite the nominal accuracy gate passing.
The mean learned on-minus-off peak task-risk gap became positive but remained below the configured 0.2 gate.
With target R and frozen U, only one of five groups can attain the fixed 0.2 risk gap; the objective is incompatible with four of five supervision geometries.
Target R is very sparse, with group means from approximately 0.00086 to 0.00443, so unweighted BCE can be small while predicting mostly background.
required_repairs_before_next_gpu_smoke: Replace unweighted relevance BCE with a foreground-balanced spatial objective and report positive-region recall plus background false-positive rate.
Replace the fixed absolute 0.2 gap with a preregistered target-geometry-aware ordering metric, such as sign correctness plus a fraction of the attainable oracle gap.
Replace overall stance accuracy with balanced metrics: on-path conservative recall, off-path specificity, zero-UQ specificity, and minimum target probability.
Repair QA answer construction or language supervision and require valid generated answers plus agreement between generated stance and structured stance.
Pass a small tensor/head-level overfit diagnostic on the same five groups before allocating another full ORION smoke.
claim_boundary: Engineering smoke diagnosis only. This provides no held-out, generalization, trajectory, closed-loop, or safety evidence.
